thread:
erin: FYI opened a quick docs PR — examples for POST /v1/generate are showing `top_p` as a string in the JSON sample ("0.9") which breaks our Go/TS SDK examples. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4897

sam: Oh dang, thanks for catching. Which file?

erin: docs/reference/generate.md — the request example has a few types wrong: `top_p` and `temperature` quoted, and `max_new_tokens` is missing in the example response so it looks like server returns it as string in the SDK snippet.

kai: I can take the SDK snippet fix in the TS client if you want. Is this purely docs or do we need a server change?

erin: Purely docs. The runtime returns numbers. The example JSON is invalid and caused a couple of users to paste it into their configs.

luis: Posted a small comment on the PR — suggest we also add a short note in the migration guide about strict types for generation params (some older examples used strings).

erin: Good call, add under docs/migration/2025-xx-generation-types.md. Keep it tiny: "Examples using stringified numbers (e.g., \"0.9\") may be parsed by some clients incorrectly—use numeric types."

sam: I'll update the Python snippet too, saw it used f-strings to interpolate and accidentally added quotes. Will push a commit to the PR in ~30m.

kai: TS commit ready, changing the example payload from:

```json
{
  "model": "redwood-v1",
  "prompt": "Summarize",
  "temperature": "0.2",
  "top_p": "0.9",
  "max_new_tokens": 150
}
```

to:

```json
{
  "model": "redwood-v1",
  "prompt": "Summarize",
  "temperature": 0.2,
  "top_p": 0.9,
  "max_new_tokens": 150
}
```

kaI: Also changed the SDK snippet to use the typed helper `GenerationParams` so editors will highlight type mismatches.

docs-bot: PR 4897 — labels: docs, quickfix; reviewers: @sam, @kai

luis: One more tiny thing — the response example has `token_count": "23"` (quoted). I left an inline suggestion to make it numeric and add a note: `token_count` is an integer in responses.

erin: Awesome. After the changes, please also update the example curl command that pipes through `jq` — jq fails if it expects numbers but sees strings.

sam: Good catch. I'll run the curl -> jq snippet locally after updating.

kai: I pushed TS changes and clarified the TypeScript example comment about types.

erin: Thanks all — once sam's python/curl updates are in I’ll merge. Adding a tiny test in the docs CI to validate example JSON is syntactically correct before deploy.

luis: If you want I can add a small GH action step that runs `jq .` on examples folder — quick guard.

erin: Please do, that'd prevent regressions.

docs-bot: PR 4897 merged by erin — changelog: docs: fix example types for /v1/generate, add migration note.
